title: Add OpaqueRange interface
body: Introduce OpaqueRange, a live AbstractRange subtype for range-based operations over encapsulated content without exposing internal DOM nodes. Its boundary points participate in the existing live-range mutation algorithms. The creating specification defines and maintains exposed offsets, which may differ from the internal boundary-point offsets. This replaces #1404 and incorporates the preparations landed in #1470 and #1522. HTML defines creation for text controls, while CSSOM View defines the geometry methods.
